title: Tiny, cute drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum body (cylinder side) -->
  <rect x="24" y="42" width="52" height="34" rx="4" fill="#e8432f"/>
  <!-- drum body shading -->
  <rect x="24" y="48" width="52" height="6" fill="#c93021"/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <!-- top drum head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="23" ry="7.5" fill="#faf0d7"/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="26" ry="9" fill="#d9a82e"/>
  <rect x="24" y="70" width="52" height="8" fill="#d9a82e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="26" ry="9" fill="#b8860b"/>
  <!-- zigzag drum decoration -->
  <polyline points="30,58 36,52 42,58 48,52 54,58 60,52 66,58 70,54"
    fill="none" stroke="#f5c542" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- left tension rod -->
  <rect x="28" y="42" width="3" height="34" rx="1.5" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <!-- right tension rod -->
  <rect x="69" y="42" width="3" height="34" rx="1.5" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <!-- center tension rod -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="49" width="3" height="27" rx="1.5" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1="18" y1="30" x2="44" y2="44" stroke="#c99b5e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="29" r="3.5" fill="#e8b86d"/>
  <line x1="82" y1="30" x2="56" y2="44" stroke="#c99b5e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="29" r="3.5" fill="#e8b86d"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="20" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#7fd1e8" transform="rotate(-20 22 20)"/>
  <rect x="24.2" y="12" width="1.8" height="8" fill="#7fd1e8"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="17" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#9be87f" transform="rotate(-20 76 17)"/>
  <rect x="78.2" y="9" width="1.8" height="8" fill="#9be87f"/>
  <!-- little star -->
  <polygon points="50,12 52,17 57,17 53,20 55,25 50,22 45,25 47,20 43,17 48,17"
    fill="#ffe066"/>
</svg>
